title: Leap year
description:
Write `bool isLeapYear(int year)`.

A year is a leap year when it divides by 4, **except** that century years (those that divide by 100) only count when they also divide by 400.

| Year | Leap? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 2024 | yes | divides by 4 |
| 2023 | no | does not divide by 4 |
| 1900 | no | century, not divisible by 400 |
| 2000 | yes | century, divisible by 400 |

Combine the three tests with `&&`, `||` and `!=`. No `if` is needed.
hints: In words: (divides by 4 **and** not by 100) **or** divides by 400.
